business_summary: FuJian YanJing HuiQuan Brewery Co.,Ltd produces and sells beer in China. The company offers Huiquan Wheat, Huiquan Pure Draft, Huiquan European Knight, Huiquan Fresh Beer, Huiquan 1983, and the Old Huiquan beer series products. It is also involved in waste material recycling and sales; and trade activities. The company was formerly known as Fujian Huiquan Brewery Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to FuJian YanJing HuiQuan Brewery Co.,Ltd in May 2004. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Quanzhou City, China. FuJian YanJing HuiQuan Brewery Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd.
business_summary_ko: FuJian YanJing HuiQuan Brewery Co.,Ltd는 중국에서 맥주를 ​​생산 및 판매합니다. 회사는 Huiquan Wheat, Huiquan Pure Draft, Huiquan European Knight, Huiquan Fresh Beer, Huiquan 1983 및 Old Huiquan 맥주 시리즈 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 폐기물 재활용 및 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 그리고 무역 활동. 이 회사는 이전에 Fujian Huiquan Brewery Group Co., Ltd.로 알려져 있었으며 2004년 5월에 FuJian YanJing HuiQuan Brewery Co.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 취안저우시에 본사를 두고 있습니다. FuJian YanJing HuiQuan Brewery Co.,Ltd는 Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd의 자회사입니다.
